name: memory_deduper
description: Memory quality maintenance tool. Detects duplicate/conflicting memories, confidence-scores each fact, and proposes safe cleanup actions. DEFAULT BEHAVIOR: run action='analyze' first. Only use action='apply' when user explicitly asks to apply changes and provides/approves group_ids from analysis. Use for requests like: 'clean up memory', 'find duplicate facts', 'detect contradictions in memory', 'dedupe my memories'.

action.description: Mode selector. analyze = scan only (safe, default). apply = execute deletions for selected groups. Always analyze first unless user explicitly requests applying changes.

group_ids.description: Required for action=apply. Group IDs from a previous analyze run (e.g. exact_abc123...).

apply_mode.description: Apply safety level. exact_only (recommended) only applies exact duplicate groups. exact_and_probable is more aggressive.

dry_run.description: Safety switch for apply mode. true = preview only, no DB changes. false = actually delete selected duplicates.

include_categories.description: Optional allowlist of categories to scan (e.g. ['technical','fact','preference']).

exclude_categories.description: Optional blocklist of categories to skip. If omitted, defaults to ['stash_artifact'] to reduce noisy artifact duplicates.

scan_limit.description: Max memories to scan (default 1200, max 5000). Increase for broader analysis, decrease for faster runs.

max_pair_checks.description: Max pairwise comparisons for similarity checks (default 60000). If this cap is hit, analysis may be partial.

key_similarity_threshold.description: Threshold for considering keys similar (default 0.82). Higher = stricter grouping.

value_duplicate_threshold.description: Threshold for probable duplicate values (default 0.90). Higher = fewer probable duplicate matches.

value_conflict_threshold.description: Threshold for conflict values when keys are similar (default 0.45). Lower = fewer conflict detections.

save_to_stash.description: Save markdown dedupe report to stash. Default: true for analyze, false for apply.

save_to_canvas.description: Save dedupe report as a canvas page for visual review. Default false.
